source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: In autoregressive generation, what happens to a token after it is selected?

options.text: It becomes part of the context for later token choices.
options.feedback: Each choice extends the sequence. The growing sequence influences which tokens are likely next.

options.text: It replaces the trained weights used for later token choices.
options.feedback: Generated text changes context, not the trained weights during ordinary inference.

options.text: It is held apart until the complete answer has been selected.
options.feedback: The answer is generated incrementally. Earlier generated tokens influence later choices before the whole answer exists.

options.text: It supplies a new independent layer for the decoder stack.
options.feedback: Adding a token grows the sequence. It does not add another learned layer to the model.
